content_sections.heading: DPLC Dantewada Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Boys Hostel Superintendent, 1 for Girls Hostel Superintendent, 1 for Office Assistant, 1 for Manager cum Office Assistant, and 1 for Peon.

content_sections.heading: DPLC Dantewada Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Office Assistant: 12th pass with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized board; 1-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming with a minimum of 60%. Manager cum Office Assistant: Graduate with a minimum of 50% marks from a UGC recognized university; 1-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming with a minimum of 50%. Peon: 5th pass; Must be a resident of Dantewada district.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DPLC Dantewada Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DPLC Dantewada?
faq.answer: District Project Livelihood College Dantewada has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Hostel Superintendent and Office Staff.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for DPLC Dantewada recruitment is scheduled to be held on 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications range from 5th pass for Peon to Graduate with specific diploma requirements for Superintendent and Office Staff positions.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for DPLC Dantewada recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the different posts?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs. 10882.00 for Peon to Rs. 13092.00 for Hostel Superintendent and Office Assistant roles.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Hostel Superintendent and Office Staff positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill Test, Interview, Document Verification, and the finalization of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. Which district is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for District Project Livelihood College Dantewada, located in Dantewada, Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and passport-size photographs.
